title: 13 moons
text:
Bravely forward!
boldly onward 
Not to wander 
but to know to wonder
To howl and dance 
at each new moons swirl 
to let it, 
not slip past in pasts this pearl.
Only thirteen and another sun seen
Will you remember where you’ve been?

title: What is to live?
text:
What is to live if not to love?
If not the glistening of the warm winter sun against the duck’s refuge?
If not the effortless, effortful hustle of the weaver in the tall tufts?
If not the wave of the bye-bye leaf celebrating every gust of the wind?
If not the hairs on my arm dancing to the same breeze?
If not to know that here too I belong, what is to live?
